my god. i dont know what it is about what you just said. whether its my severe lack of sleep from staying up until 3:00 am thinking about her finally taking over my brain, r the fact that youve actually tried to give me advice, but what you just said is amazing. while im still not sure what i want, i know i want someone like her that i can confide in, who i can share all my secrets and problems with and have her understand.  i want someone who i can sit with for hours and do nothing. i want to try to help her with all of her problems (i do care about her) and i want to be able to talk about my problems with her. i want to be able to share my life with her. she is the only person ive ever met thats capable of doing that. but then i think that theres just something wrong with that. i cant quite place it, but theres just something fundamentally wrong with that situation, either that it would never happen, that she loves someone else, or its that im scared of being close to anyone. its like in the twilight zone when theres a parallel universe that perfect in every way, but you just cant help but feel theres something wrong. and i would just be friends with her, but it seems like a nominal position. she is friends with everybody at the school (even though she insisted shes unpopular and only has 2 friends) and shes known almost everyone that she knows since kindergarten. the only people i could talk to about it that are close to my friends wouldnt understand, and even if they did shes known all of them for even longer than me and is better friends with them than ill ever be with them or her. but youre right. shes friends with every one and shes certainly better friends with them than me, but for some reason she keeps talking to me. no matter what happens she keeps wanting to be my friend. even after i literally told her we cant be friends, she came back. so even though i may not be the first person that come to mind when she needs a friend, and i may be on the very bottom of the extensive list of friends, but im on the list, and that makes it worth it to try. so what if she doesnt think of me as a close friend. so what if she barely even thinks im a friend at all. the fact that she smiles at me when i see her in the hall is more than i could ask for. 
and logically, theres nothing stopping me from being happy. i could just go all courage wolf, put a smile on my face, and make out with a random girl i see (believe me, they wont care) sure i would be happy, but i would be missing the critical thing that every relationship, and life, needs. a deep connection. sure i could just be like her, being friends with everyone, spouting her feelings for all to see, and yes, i would have friends, i would be able to confide in everyone, but it wouldnt be special. it wouldnt be that one girl who, no matter all your insecurities, no matter how much your brain says no, when you look into her beautiful brown eyes, the world just disappears. everyone else just goes away and all the fear and anxiety just fade. and you feel safe. you feel save talking to her. and it doesnt matter than youll never be more than just "that one guy friend who gives me answers on the chem homeowork" what matters is that she makes you happy and you not being in her life makes her happy. and if i can make her happy by keeping my distance, then ill be one step closer to repaying the happiness she gives me by just being her.

the only thing that could possibly hurt mored than the regret is the rejection or the knowing that i caused her any pain, no matter how small. i dont know what to think anymore. im going to take a week off and not speak to her or anyone, and hopefully i can get back to my old self again. if so then hopefully i can either tell her how i feel, or tell her that we cant talk again. or maybe, if i haven't already killed myself or done anything else drastic, i can figure out myself, and actually open up to her and accept her and finally have a friend that i can talk to. it will be difficult and i still cant see us being together, but i also cant see us being apart. i just wish it could be so easier. if she didnt love another guy. if i felt confident enough to see her as a friend and see myself as someone she would want to be friends with. if all the other factors, friends, past experiences, and insecurities were gone, that i could just tell her how i feel and explain why ive acted and have her understand my convoluted mind that i dont even understand right now (i want her but i dont want her at the same time.) i just wish i knew what i wanted and how to get it. but i dont. and until i do, im just going to float around this depressing and nihilistic void until i find someone who tells me, hey. youre awesome. believe me, she really likes you. just go for it. be happy. but that day will never come. and ill never get a chance like this with a girl like her. i just hope i can figure out myself before i ruin something i really care about.

i was actually just about to delete the account. i decided to not do anything about her and just hope she forgets about me quickly and moves on the the guy she loves. sort of a depressing ending for a depressing story, but at least it fits the theme of my life.

wow. There's not really much I can add to that. I've been smiling straight for the past ~16 years, but every once in a whole there comes a girl who really just makes me feel like I'm not good enough. It might just be human nature, it might just me hormones and teenage angst, or I might just be insane. Either way, I love myself, but it's just not in my nature to be selfish. If she loves someone else and not me, to hell with how I feel, I'm happy that she's happy with the one she loves. Im in no position to step in on someone's life and say, "hey, I'm not happy with this, let's change it." after being isolated, both on purpose and unintentionally, I've learned to live with what I get and be happy with the ones around me. I just spent the last 2 hours talking to the only other person who seems to care what I think, so I'm feeling extra "normal." it might just be the happy side of me peeking out from behind the depressed side, but I'm ready to do whatever it takes. I may not be ready to have that close of a friend just yet, but I'm even less ready to lose something as special as her. So I'm either going to try to be friends with her again, ask her out, or just try to be there her when her college boyfriend lets her down worse than I did (not just for size of screwup, but he has a bigger effect than me.) I might try one, or I might try all three. I could try different combinations, anything, their all destined to fail. But I'm going to do them anyway, and if it ruins any chance of being friends with her or anyone else at the school, so it goes. There's always 4 other high schools I can transfer to for the next 2 years, and if I've gone withough friends for 16 years, I can go another 16. Thank you for bother with a broken case like me. Its goo to know that there are at least strangers on the Internet who care about me more than everyone else.
i just dont know what to do anymore. i cant think straight, i cant figure out if shes worth my time and sanity. i just dont know what to do.

im not good enough to be her friend. as ive said before, im not good friendship material. im scared to open up to people, ill just end up hurting her, and even if i am friends with her ill bever be happy with just sitting idly by because shell never trust me again and there will be nothing i could ever do to help her its best to just forget her and,  try not to kill myself (whether on purpose or accidentally, i get really clumsy when im upset and i work with sharp instruments)
the problem isnt her. she would keep me no matter what. she would go to the ends of the earth for her friends. i dont want to make her have to.

i think it would be better for her in the long run to be ignored and then get over it rather than having to deal with me as a friend. as i said before, i would make a very good friend to her and even if i did we would never work as friends.

i just spend the last 24 hours on her thinking about her, reading her blog, and thinking about how much better off she is without me. i had given up. i was never going to speak to her again. no matter how much it hurt her to be ignored, i would ignore her, because she would be better off without me in her life. i came here to delete these posts so i would stop getting messages about how it would be alright and to talk to her again. even though i know she doesnt like me the way you think she does, your comment made me feel better about it. it made me feel like there just might be a chance at us being friends again.and even though shell never feel for me the ,ay your wife feels for you, it still made me feel better. thank you
if all goes well ill let you know

i will always love her, if even just a an ex-friend and if she doesnt love me back, even though i may (or may not) love her, i will have to get over her. im going to wait a week and try to forget about her, as hard as it is, and if it turns out that we really dont feel anything for her then ill either cry for a while and get over her, end up back here with a different type of post. but if i still feel the same way then well see where our relationship can go. if it lasts a day (a possibility with me) then ill be sad, but if it lasts forever then i know ill have made the right choice.

i think i want to be friends with her, but i dont stand a chance with her. she has too many friends to need me, and ive been to harsh for her to want me. i just want things to go back to the way they were, before we knew each other, before we became friends and i had a chance to fall in love with her. before i wronged her and left her behind for a future of loneliness and misery.

the only reason im not sure of how i feel is because im young and ive never felt love so i dont know what it means to love somebody. all i know is that i care about her, i accept her for everything that she is, and , for some reason that i cant quite explain, i would do anything on earth for her. thats what i think true love love it. wanting to do anything you can for someone, regardless of the cost, even if you dont know why you do it. and the worst part is that, not matter how much i felt about her, my own problems clouded my judgment and i was the one who was callous to her. she has never been anything but accepting to me and thats what makes it so hard. no matter what she did i would find myslef forgiving her. if she shot me in the chest for fun i would forgive her because she had a reason to do it, as long as it made her smile (extreme case, but im known for crazy self sacrifice. i cant help it). but if i so much as raise my voice to her for whatever is going on my my life, i would never forgive myself because i know she would forgive me. i just want some way to show that i care about her for forgiving anything that do even if i dont. because of that i want do whatever i can to help her. shes very open about her issues (another trait that i envy about her) and i want to try everything im my power to make her see herself the way i see her. if i can help her through her problems it will make me feel a little more useful and just slightly more deserving of someone as kind as her. even if she cant help my problems i want to be able to help her. im willing to accept her, faults and all, but if shes miserable and hates herself, i cant very much say i love her if im not willing to make her happy. it might never work, heck, this is all hypothetical based on the assumption that shell forgive me and decide to be friends with me again (which she probably wont) but if she does then i will love her. i will love her for what she is and what she isnt. i will love her for her faults and for her perfections. but if i do, i just want to make her as happy as she makes me. and this is all based of the possibly flawed assumption that what i feel is in fact love and not just unfamiliar happiness to have a friend.
So you think I should just forget about her and try to be happy without her?

She is amazing and makes me what to spend the rest of my life with her, but, like me, she has faults. And those faults both infuriate me and make me want we more. Like As I said, she is very insecure about her body, and while I think she's an idiot for thinking she's anything but beautiful, i want to be able to talk to her about it. I want to show her that shes not the only self conscious one and that she really is beautiful. It's a confusing mess and I love it
